finding
column2: 🔴 `Gap 511` says "nothing in this repository tells a successor that make-refused != gate-refused".  This pass adds the symmetric half, which is larger: THE REFUSAL WAS A PROPERTY OF THE SANDBOX, NOT OF THE REPOSITORY.  p336, p376 and p377 each generalised one sandbox's limits into a statement about what this base can measure, and three passes' worth of gate state was left "unmeasured" for a reason that evaporated the moment a different sandbox ran the same command.

column1: rule
column2: 🟢 A pass must OPEN by probing its own channels — `make`, `git ls-remote`, `raw.githubusercontent.com`, `api.github.com`, `repo1.maven.org` — and record the result as a measurement OF THAT RUN.  A capability note inherited from a prior pass is a statement about a sandbox that no longer exists.  🔴 It must never be read as a property of this repository.
